relation: one input is evaluated by a primary binary condition, and exactly one primary branch unlocks a second binary condition before resolving to one of three mutually exclusive terminal outcomes

stageEvents.observable: one input and the primary condition are readable while the dependent condition remains inactive
the primary condition displays its supplied boolean result and exactly one route continues
when the continuing primary result is supplied, it visibly unlocks the second condition; otherwise the primary terminal is selected and the second condition remains inactive
when unlocked, the second condition displays its supplied boolean result and both secondary terminals are readable
exactly one of the three terminal outcomes is emphasized while the other two remain visible but inactive
the selected two-level route resolves to one final result with both condition results traceable

limits: exactly two supplied binary conditions and three mutually exclusive terminal outcomes
exactly one primary branch terminates immediately and the other unlocks the secondary condition
the secondary condition is not evaluated before the continuing primary result is established
exactly one terminal outcome is selected; both alternatives remain visible but inactive
no arbitrary-depth tree, merge, loop, probability, weighting, or parallel execution
condition order expresses routing dependency only and does not add causal claims beyond supplied rules
